entities.summary: The At-Tauhid Mosque is a Shia Islam mosque, located in the Floresta neighbourhood of Buenos Aires, Argentina. Inaugurated in October 1983, it is the oldest mosque in the country, and was established with the support of the Embassy of the Islamic Republic of Iran to Argentina. It is a simple building with a subtle Islamic style in its façade.
